appName: Sea Level Rise Explorer: Boynton Beach
displayName: Sea Level Rise Explorer: Boynton Beach
display_name: Sea Level Rise Explorer: Boynton Beach
display_long_description:
Discover Boynton Beach, FL through a new lens.
In this immersive 360° journey, explore how one of Florida’s most vibrant coastal communities is tackling climate challenges head-on. From the heart of the city to the mangrove-lined Intracoastal, experience the beauty, risks, and resilience shaping Boynton Beach’s future.

🌊 See the Story Unfold
Fly over sunlit marinas, shaded parks, and lively neighborhoods as the experience reveals how heat, flooding, and sea level rise are transforming the city. Watch as solutions take root, shade trees cooling streets, mangroves protecting shorelines, and communities coming together to plan for tomorrow.

🌱 A Vision for a Stronger Coast
Created in collaboration with the City of Boynton Beach, the Coastal Resilience Partnership of Southeast Palm Beach County, and NASA DEVELOP, this experience turns complex climate data into a story everyone can see and feel. It’s a look at what’s at stake, and how collective action is shaping a safer, more sustainable future.

✨ Step inside. Learn. Imagine. Act.
Every scene invites participation: explore, click, and visualize change. Because when technology and community come together, the future becomes something we can all shape.
